title: Vichora Dey Gaya Akbar Gaya
body:
Vichora dey gaya Akber, gaya watna te nayi aya
<<DIVIDER>>
Rabba uss dess tur jawan, jithey waseya ay maan jaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Mein odha murr k na wekharn, da manzar kiwain bul jawan
Mein odhi rah te bethi haan, nayi apna rah tou sirr chaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Muhafiz ban k payra de, nishana nu bachawan gayee
Mera ay ho fidak nana, mera ay ho hee sarmaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Keevain Mann laan k lekhan da, hoya ay waar mere te,
Mein dhi odhi han kun keh k, jiney rahib nu rang laya
<<DIVIDER>>
Karaan mansoob kiss nah tonn, mein apne dukh di manzal nu
Main raj k rohnee sakni yaan, rowawan walla nayi aya
<<DIVIDER>>
Samar zindagi Ali Akber, de hunjre te he ruk gayi si
Jinu tak tak k sugar di, Akhan da noor pathraya
